mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,created_by,status,storage_key,run_token,file_size, (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS expired FROM inventory_export_tasks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND id=#{taskId}

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM inventory_export_tasks WHERE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.user_id=u.id JOIN tenants te ON te.id=m.tenant_id WHERE u.id=#{task.createdBy} AND te.id=#{task.tenantId} AND u.enabled=1 AND m.enabled=1 AND te.enabled=1)
